And Bezaleel made the ark, etc. - For a description of the ark, see (note), etc.
He made the mercy-seat - See this described (note).
He made the vessels - See all these particularly described in the notes on (note).
He made the candlestick - See this described in the note on (note).
He made the incense altar - See this described (note).

He made the holy anointing oil - See this and the perfume, and the materials out of which they were made, described at large in the notes on and . As this chapter also is a repetition of what has been mentioned in preceding chapters, the reader is desired to refer to them.
